version.changelog: Add UTM attribution tags (utm_source=clawhub) to ClawLink branding links so visits from this skill page are tracked as a distinct traffic source.

llm.summary: This is a disclosed GitLab integration skill, with sensitive GitLab access that fits its purpose but should be installed and used carefully.

dimensions.detail: OAuth-backed GitLab access through ClawLink is proportionate for the integration, and the skill says access is scoped to the connected account.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: Setup installs and enables the ClawLink plugin by package name and restarts the gateway; this is disclosed and purpose-aligned, but the artifact does not pin a reviewed version or digest.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: The instructions repeatedly require explicit confirmation and preview before writes, but one table entry incorrectly describes archiving a project as read-only while marking it as Write.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: The plugin allowlist change and ClawLink OAuth connection persist beyond a single chat, but the behavior is documented as part of setup.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

dimensions.detail: The skill’s GitLab read/write capabilities match its stated purpose, including project, issue, branch, member, status, and CI/CD operations.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

llm.guidance: Before installing, understand that this enables a third-party ClawLink plugin and connects it to your GitLab account through OAuth. Use a least-privileged GitLab account or scopes where possible, review every preview before write actions, and be aware that archiving is a state-changing action despite one misleading read-only label.
llm.findings:
[SDI-4] unexpected: The archive-project row contains a real documentation contradiction, but surrounding security and workflow instructions classify archiving as high-impact and require confirmation before writes.
[T08] expected: Installing and enabling the ClawLink plugin is expected for this skill, but the mutable package reference leaves normal supply-chain risk because the reviewed artifact does not include or pin the plugin implementation.
